stories.article_text_excerpt: Romania ended five months of political paralysis Tuesday with its parliament voting in Luca Niculescu as prime minister after three failed attempts to form a government — but the deal comes with a six-month deadline for the parties to strike a more lasting agreement. The threat of snap elections, which would likely see the populist right-wing Alliance for the Union of Romanians (AUR) party surge, helped push the center-right National Liberal Party (PNL) and the center-left Social Democrats (PSD) to agree on a government led by independent Niculescu, a former journalist and diplomat who was nominated as prime minister by moderate President Nicușor Dan earlier this month. The socialists will join the cabinet, but the liberals will stay out. Romania has the sixth-largest population in the EU and plays a critical role in NATO’s defense of southeastern Europe as home to a major military base and a U.S. missile shield site. The country has been plagued by political instability and a mushrooming budget deficit in recent years, fueling a surge in support for hard-right nationalist politics. stories.title: Brutal, revolutionary empire builder: Genghis Khan's legacy
stories.summary: Berlin is host to a major exhibition on the founder of the Mongol Empire and his successors. Here's how Genghis Khan disrupted the course of history.

A blood-thirsty invader whose conquests caused the deaths of an estimated 40 million people, he was also a visionary political thinker who established the largest contiguous land empire in history. The founder of the Mongolian Empire died in 1227. Beállítom Budapesten fogadta Magyar Péter az izraeli elnököt, Jichák Hercogot – jelentette be a Facebookon a magyar miniszterelnök. „Egyetértettünk abban, hogy mindannyiunk érdeke az Izrael és Magyarország között meglévő szoros történelmi, kulturális, gazdasági és védelmi együttműködés további erősítése” – írta Magyar Péter, aki örömmel elfogadta Hercog meghívását egy izraeli látogatásra. Hercog kedden tárgyalt Baka András köztársasági elnökkel is. Az MTI szerint a tárgyalás után azt mondta, a magyar és izraeli nép is tudja, hogy a szabadság nincs ingyen, de érdemes küzdeni érte, még ha magas is az ára.
